title: IT Manager
description: Job Title: IT Manager Location: This is a fully remote opportunity and can be worked from any location in the United States. About Us 1mind is building the next generation of revenue teams. We are creating a new category of enterprise software: Autonomous Customer Experience. Our platform deploys Superhumans , go-to-market teammates with a face, a voice, and a GTM brain that serve the buyer across the entire journey with one continuous memory. They engage, demo, onboard, and support in the moments no company could ever staff, so the handoffs disappear and growth stops leaking. Join us as we define the category and build the platform that powers the next generation of revenue teams. When the buyer wins, the company wins. Every1 Wins. About the Role Weâre looking for a hands-on IT Manager to manage 1mindâs internal technology, from laptops and logins to software purchases and vendor contracts. Weâre adding people, tools and compliance requirements fast, and this role makes sure everyone has what they need on day one, every dollar we spend on software is the right call, and we stay secure and continuously audit ready as we scale. This is an individual contributor role, a great fit for a hands-on doer who likes scaling systems and wants real ownership to steward this rocketship to the next level. What Youâll Do Be the go-to for all employee IT needs. Scale and run our help desk with a service mindset, and keep policies, runbooks and the knowledge base current Own the employee IT lifecycle, from devices and day-one access through offboarding. Manage SSO, SCIM provisioning and least-privilege access across our apps, and fix sync issues as they come up Manage hardware inventory and core infrastructure, including our identity provider, Google Workspace, MDM and networking Own every tool from request to retirement. Run evaluations, lead selection in partnership with department leads and stakeholders, negotiate terms with Finance and Legal, then handle deployment, licensing and decommissioning Keep our vendor register and renewal calendar current so nothing auto-renews by surprise. Cut tools that are redundant, underused or overspending, including on AI/LLM usage Partner with the GRC team on SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 42001, GDPR and CCPA/CPRA. Run vendor security assessments and access reviews, enforce controls like MFA, and support audits and incident response What Youâll Bring 5+ years (or equivalent experience) in IT operations, systems administration or IT management, ideally at a fast-growing SaaS or tech company Hands-on experience administering an identity provider (SSO and SCIM across many SaaS apps), Google Workspace and an MDM/endpoint platform A track record of sourcing software, negotiating vendor contracts and managing a SaaS budget Familiarity with SOC 2 and ISO 27001, and comfort supporting audits with clean evidence and documentation Strong organization and a service mindset, with the ability to juggle tickets alongside bigger projects and a bias for automating the fix over closing the same ticket twice Bonus points if youâve used Rippling, SentinelOne, Atlassian, Vanta, or Ramp, if youâve been the first or only IT hire at a startup, or if youâve worked with ISO 42001 or AI governance Why Join Us This is an opportunity to help define a new category at one of the most exciting moments in enterprise AI. Youâll work alongside a team of builders who move quickly, take ownership, and care deeply about solving meaningful problems. If youâre energized by ambiguity, excited to shape whatâs next, and want your work to have an outsized impact, weâd love to meet you! The salary range for this position is $140,000 to $170,000 . The compensation package for this position also includes stock options and company-paid benefits. 1mind's total compensation package is designed to be competitive and includes base salary, equity, and a full range of benefits and perks. Final compensation will depend on factors such as your skills, experience, qualifications, and location, and will be determined during the interview process. The hiring manager will share more details about the full compensation package and benefits as you move through the process. We believe in providing interesting and meaningful work in a supportive and inclusive environment - free from discrimination for everyone without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity, or veteran status. If you are passionate about learning and excited about what we are doing, then we want to hear from you! If you receive a suspicious message, please disregard it and alert us at careers@1mind.com ] We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, notetaking, or summarizing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment - all hiring decisions are made by people. title: Senior Director of Product Management (R14361)
description: Who We Are Oportun (Nasdaq: OPRT) is a mission-driven financial services company that puts its members' financial goals within reach. With intelligent borrowing, savings, and budgeting capabilities, Oportun empowers members with the confidence to build a better financial future. Since inception, Oportun has provided more than $22.7 billion in responsible and affordable credit, saved its members more than $2.5 billion in interest and fees, and helped its members set aside an average of more than $1,800 annually. The Opportunity Weâre looking for a Senior Director of Product Management to lead strategy, growth, and execution across key digital products and member experiences. Youâll help shape how Oportun serves members throughout their financial journey while building products that create meaningful customer value and support sustainable business growth. This is a hands-on leadership role. Youâll set product direction, develop roadmaps, lead discovery, guide cross-functional execution, and coach product managers while staying close to customers, data, and product performance. Success requires strong strategic judgment, deep customer empathy, and the ability to move comfortably between long-term vision and detailed execution. At Oportun, we move fast and we hold each other to a high bar. If you care about doing your best work while actually moving the needle for real people, you'll fit right in. What You'll Do Your day-to-day Youâll define product vision, strategy, and priorities that connect member needs with Oportunâs business objectives. Youâll own and evolve a portfolio of digital products and experiences, balancing growth, engagement, retention, customer value, and business performance. Youâll build outcome-focused roadmaps and make clear investment decisions across existing products, new capabilities, and emerging opportunities. Youâll develop a deep understanding of member behavior, friction points, and unmet needs through research, product analytics, funnel analysis, cohort performance, and experimentation. Youâll lead product initiatives from discovery and validation through launch, measurement, iteration, and scale. Youâll establish clear hypotheses, success measures, and performance metrics and use results to guide future product decisions. Youâll partner closely with Design, Engineering, Analytics, Marketing, Operations, Risk, Compliance, and other teams to resolve trade-offs and deliver strong member experiences. Youâll balance customer experience, growth, product economics, risk, regulatory requirements, and operational complexity when making product decisions. Youâll coach and develop product managers, set clear expectations, and strengthen product judgment, ownership, and accountability across the team. Youâll communicate product strategy, priorities, performance, risks, and trade-offs clearly to senior leaders and cross-functional partners. Youâll bring ideas for how we can improve our products, processes, and ways of working, proactively, not just when asked. Youâll look for practical ways to use AI to improve product discovery, analysis, experimentation, decision-making, and team productivity. You'll look for ways to use AI tools thoughtfully â to work smarter, reduce manual work, and make better decisions faster Who You Are The right fit looks like this Youâre a strategic and hands-on product leader who combines strong customer judgment with data, business acumen, and disciplined execution. You know how to build products that customers value while making thoughtful trade-offs across growth, economics, risk, and operational complexity. Youâre comfortable leading through ambiguity, making decisions with incomplete information, and creating clarity across teams. You communicate directly, build strong partnerships, and stay close enough to the work to understand what is working, what is not, and where the team should focus next. Youâre also a strong people leader. You know how to coach product managers, raise the quality of product thinking, and create accountability for measurable outcomes. You're comfortable navigating complexity and don't wait for perfect information to move forward. You communicate clearly, give direct feedback, and expect the same in return. What You Bring Skills & experience Required 8+ years of product management experience, with increasing responsibility for product strategy, roadmap ownership, and measurable customer and business outcomes. Significant experience building and growing consumer digital products. Proven experience owning engagement, retention, growth, monetization, or other meaningful product-performance outcomes. 3+ years of experience directly managing and developing product managers. Strong track record leading cross-functional teams from discovery through launch, measurement, and iteration. Experience setting product strategy and translating it into focused, executable roadmaps. Strong product judgment and a high standard for simple, intuitive, and customer-centered experiences. Strong analytical skills, including experience with funnel analysis, cohort performance, product economics, experimentation, and performance measurement. Experience evolving established products while balancing current customer needs with new strategic priorities. Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to align senior stakeholders around priorities, risks, and trade-offs. Ability to operate effectively in fast-moving environments with competing priorities and significant ambiguity. Nice to Have Experience in fintech, financial services, lending, banking, payments, savings, budgeting, investing, or financial wellness. Experience building consumer mobile products or other high-engagement digital experiences. Experience with subscription, recurring-use, or habit-forming consumer products. Experience serving customers managing complex or variable financial needs. Experience working in a regulated environment and incorporating Risk, Legal, and Compliance requirements into product experiences. Experience leading products through periods of growth, transformation, or significant strategic change. Experience using AI tools to improve product research, analysis, experimentation, documentation, or team productivity. Our AI Mindset We build with AI. We lead with judgment. AI isn't a feature here. It's how we work. We're excited about what AI makes possible, and we're looking for people who share that curiosity. You don't need to be an expert. You need to be open to experimenting , willing to learn, and able to apply new tools in ways that actually move the needle. In this role, you'll be encouraged to explore AI tools, find practical use cases for your function, and bring ideas for working smarter. We believe the best outcomes come when human judgment and AI capability work together. title: Sr. Manager, GTM Engineering
description: Our Mission: 6sense 's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency. We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential. Our People: People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging. Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology. 6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers. We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career. Senior Manager, GTM Engineering Marketing Operations | Reports to: Sr. Director, Marketing Operations | Direct reports: 1 (BDR Operations Specialist) About the Role 6sense's Marketing Operations team builds the technical backbone behind our go-to-market motion: systems integration, campaign orchestration, and AI-assisted workflows across the marketing and BDR stack. This role will create the AI architecture, agents, and workflows that power our agentic GTM motion. Why this role, why now 6sense is building the intelligence engine for agentic go-to-market, and this role is central to how our own Marketing team puts that strategy into practice. What you build will run our pipeline motion and get regular visibility from leaders across the company. It's a rare chance to build agentic GTM inside the company defining it. The Sr. Manager, GTM Engineering builds the automations, integrations, and AI agents that let Marketing scale output efficiently while increasing productivity and impact. That spans core GTM engineering (lead capture, routing, and BDR handoff), BDR prospecting automation, agentic support for content and campaign creation, and ABM personalization across Marketing. This is a hands-on technical role with management responsibilities. You'll independently weigh tradeoffs across speed, scale, data quality, privacy, AI governance, adoption, and pipeline impact, and serve as the go-to technical voice on what's scalable and sound, turning strategy into working systems that marketers and BDRs actually use. You'll own GTM engineering priorities and delivery across Marketing and BDR teams, partnering with Marketing Operations, Revenue/Growth Marketing, Customer and Event Marketing, BDR Leadership, RevOps, and IT. Key Responsibilities AI Agent & Workflow Architecture Build agentic workflows for end-to-end campaign creation, from brief intake to first-draft assets, using Claude and comparable enterprise LLM platforms. Orchestrate agents across MCP connectors to optimize AI usage across the stack. Partner with Growth, Customer, and Event Marketing to cut manual production time on recurring campaign types, with human review in the loop. Automate Marketing work management. For example, create workflows that allow marketers to build campaign assets leveraging centralized context governing product positioning, use cases, personas, and marketing channel best practices. Build reusable patterns, templates, and playbooks so Marketing teams can adopt automations without GTM Engineering support. GTM Systems Architecture & Integration Be our own best customer: Build the best-in-class use of the 6sense platform within a headless GTM architecture, using 6sense data and intelligence through external tools, APIs, and MCP. Build BDR prospecting automation, including signal-based account prioritization, research assembly, outreach drafting, and task automation, to increase high-quality pipeline per BDR. Own the BDR technology stack, including the sales engagement platform and dialer, with BDR leadership and your BDR Operations Specialist. Partner with BDR leaders to find productivity bottlenecks, then prioritize, ship, and measure fixes. Governance, Experimentation & Iteration Embed security, privacy, and compliance into workflows and agents by design, including data handling, agent permissions, and access controls, in partnership with Business Technology and Security. Flag design or scale risk in workflows and agents before they ship. Run technical experiments on automation and agent logic, and iterate on performance data and pipeline impact with BDR and Marketing leadership. Team Leadership & Influence Manage, coach, and prioritize work for one direct report (BDR Operations Specialist), developing their ownership of BDR tooling and process. Run intake and prioritization of automation requests across competing stakeholders, and influence senior Marketing and Revenue leaders without relying on authority. Required Qualifications 7+ years in marketing operations, GTM/revenue systems engineering, or marketing automation, with ownership of complex GTM systems, cross-functional roadmap delivery, and executive stakeholder management. Hands-on experience building automations and integrations across a marketing/RevOps stack, such as Salesforce, Marketo, and 6sense or comparable ABM/intent platforms (APIs, webhooks, iPaaS). Strong understanding of top-of-funnel GTM and BDR/SDR operations: lead routing, scoring, handoff SLAs, sales engagement and dialer tooling, and attribution. Experience building AI-assisted workflows or agents in a business context using Claude or comparable LLM platforms, with working fluency orchestrating agents through MCP connectors or similar. Experience building content and campaign automation workflows, from brief intake to first-draft assets. B2B SaaS or subscription GTM experience, ideally across multiple regions, segments, or sales motions. Experience managing, mentoring, or technically leading others. Ability to translate business needs into practical technical delivery plans and build effective relationships across Marketing, Sales, RevOps, and IT. Who You Are Curious and a natural problem solver: you dig into root causes, not just the request in front of you. Proactive with a strong bias to act: you form theories and test them on your own, without waiting to be asked, move fast within guardrails, measure the results, and retire what doesn't work. A strategic translator: you turn business strategy into tangible actions, workflows, and systems. Comfortable with visibility: you communicate credibly with senior leaders across Marketing, Sales, and the executive team. Preferred Qualifications Experience building ABM personalization and GTM workflows at scale. Experience automating work-management tools such as Asana. Familiarity with attribution platforms such as Dreamdata. Exposure to AI governance and responsible-AI practices. Success Measures Increase in high-quality pipeline generated per BDR to contribute to bookings. Measurable improvement in speed-to-lead and routing accuracy from lead capture to BDR handoff. Measurable reduction in BDR manual and administrative time. AI-assisted workflows and agents that run reliably in production with real adoption across Marketing, not just GTM and outbound. Measurable reduction in manual production time for campaign creation and ABM personalization. Zero production incidents from agents or automations reaching customers or prospects without review. Base Salary Range: $150,081.25 - $180,852.50. The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high end of the base salary range for this position. Actual salaries may vary and may be above or below the range based on various factors, including but not limited to work location and experience. The base salary is one component of 6sense’s total compensation package for this position. Other compensation may include a bonus program or commission plan, and stock options if approved by 6sense’s board. In addition, 6sense provides a variety of benefits, including generous health insurance coverage, life, and disability insurance, a 401K employer matching program, paid holidays, self-care days, and paid time off (PTO). #Li-remote Notice of Collection and Use of Personal Information for California Residents: California Recruitment Privacy Notice and Policy Our Benefits: Full-time employees can take advantage of health coverage, paid parental leave, generous paid time-off and holidays, quarterly self-care days off, and stock options. Employee well-being is also top of mind for us. We host quarterly wellness education sessions to encourage self care and personal growth. From wellness days to ERG-hosted events, we celebrate and energize all 6sense employees and their backgrounds.
